name: Linear
tagline: Issue tracking and product workflows with a strong API.
shortDescription: A polished issue tracker with GraphQL API, webhooks, OAuth, and team/project workflows.
agentSummary: Agents can create, update, search, and triage issues, projects, comments, and related Linear objects through GraphQL or Linear's official MCP server.
bestFor: Issue triage, roadmaps, changelogs, and lightweight project operations.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: Workspace conventions and prioritization still need team context. Project, CRM, document, and spreadsheet writes depend on team context and privacy rules; require least-privilege scopes and review for workflow-changing actions. MCP servers inherit the connected account's scopes and may send prompts or data to third-party services; configure read-only or narrow scopes when available. API automation needs client-side throttling, idempotency where supported, pagination limits, retries, and audit logging.
pricingSummary: Public per-seat pricing with free and paid plans.
authModel: API keys, OAuth apps, webhooks, and authenticated remote MCP.
browserSupport: Browser UI is highly usable for manual review and operations.

capabilities.detail: GraphQL API supports issues, comments, projects, cycles, and teams.
Official authenticated remote MCP server supports finding, creating, and updating Linear objects such as issues, projects, and comments.
Developer docs include schema, webhooks, and OAuth.
Public per-seat pricing with free and paid plans.
UI is quick for issue browsing and edits.
